Relatively high exposure does not equal high risk. Automation replaces standard research tasks, not strategic insight. Insightful planners become scarcer as efficiency rises, while analysts limited to extracting numbers face pressure.
Start in marketing or statistics and practice insight development. Pure research is contracting in the AI era, so learn strategy early.

Highlight projects and conversions, clearly identifying the categories served. Employers value reliability and market understanding.
